title: Document and regression-pin the accepted end of automatic source observation after a confirmed root clear
outcome: The post-clear trust boundary is explicit: later edits outside any retained captured scope are not automatically observed; this never asserts the old source stayed unchanged or permits completion with a truthfully differing fingerprint to consume its old evaluation. No perpetual watcher is introduced.
acceptance: Document that confirmed clear/release ends future automatic source observation for that claim until an explicit new root selection; already captured accounting and carried-check duties retain their original scope and are not discarded.

A regression distinguishes absence of post-clear automatic observation from the existing completion-fingerprint equality guard, using the truthful current fingerprint with no fallback to the last evaluated fingerprint.

Any implementation or documentation change retains the parent item's unchanged-source/no-fallback guarantee and the separately required old-scope owed-close recovery tests; no watcher or credit authority is expanded.
